# Pull Request Template

**Please follow this template for all pull requests.**

---


## Description

*Provide a clear and concise description of the changes in this pull request. What problem does it solve? What new feature does it add?

*Reference any related issues (e.g., `Closes #123`).

## Type of Change

*   [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
*   [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
*   [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
*   [ ] Refactor (code style, formatting, etc.)
*   [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

*   [ ] I have read the **CONTRIBUTING.md** guide.
*   [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (**Ruff**, **uv**, **Python 3.10+**).
*   [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
*   [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
*   [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation.
*   [ ] My changes generate no new warnings.
*   [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
*   [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.
*   [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published.

## Technical Details

*   **Repository:** `https://github.com/chirag127/CopyrightScan-Delisting-Analysis-Python-Project`
*   **AI Agent Directives:** Refer to `.github/AGENTS.md` for detailed operational parameters.
*   **Development Environment:** Ensure your local environment mirrors the specifications outlined in the `README.md` and `AGENTS.md` to guarantee seamless CI/CD pipeline integration.

## Screenshots (if applicable)

*Provide screenshots or recordings to help reviewers understand the changes.
